notes: Bay Area Reporter, 1 January 1998 to 30 December 1999, 105 weekly issues, read from the Internet Archive's DjVu text (no hOCR). Hand-curated: address clusters and event-word passages were read and each finding's quote checked against the issue. People rule as in the dossier: no owners, managers, staff, performers or patrons.

coverage.remaining: 2000 to 2005 remain: 291 issues in the collection, January 2000 to 28 July 2005.
coverage.note: 105 issues; 14,532 numbered-address mentions on EAS streets, 1,021 windows after the advertisement filter (616 of them rescued for an event word) in 898 address clusters, of which 452 hold an event word; the tighter filter left 101, all read; plus 867 event-word passages, of which the 20 with a fire, closing, lost-lease or moving word and no out-of-town or review marker were read. 27 findings written, each quote found again in the issue's text. 23 resolved and published on 22 pages, none seeded. 1 held (4023 18th Street, on a parcel with no page). 3 unresolved, at numbers EAS no longer holds between two parcels (505 Castro, 378 11th, 3248 16th). The audit flags 3 of 27 whose number is not on the cited leaf (456 Castro, 2362 Market, 3583 16th): the paper names the business there and prints the number in other issues, as each finding's placement note says. Not entered: Rhythm & Motion's 1998 opening at 1133 Mission, already on its page.
